conditionalRules.condition_when_relevant: Include dignity only when it materially changes how directly the planet can do its job. Venus rules Libra, so Venus in Libra receives this home-ground layer, parallel to Saturn in Capricorn.
conditionalRules.handoff: One opening sentence names the prior sign and its dates. Do not expand it into the standalone contrast paragraph used by slow movers.
conditionalRules.collective_test: May be folded into the close when earned; never required as a standalone layer.
